description: Distinct entries in each row and each column are disjoint; a column covers the tail above its ordinal index.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.StationarySplitting.cell_identities.{u} {κ : Cardinal.{u}}
  (M : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.StationarySplitting.UlamMatrix κ) :
  (∀ (α : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.StationarySplitting.Carrier (Order.succ κ)),
      Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (M.cell i α) (M.cell j α)) ∧
    (∀ (i : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.StationarySplitting.Carrier κ),
        Pairwise fun α β => Disjoint (M.cell i α) (M.cell i β)) ∧
      ∀ (α : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.StationarySplitting.Carrier (Order.succ κ)), ⋃ i, M.cell i α = Set.Ioi α
